threshold.doc: Bright-pass threshold: only the part above it, measured on the premultiplied RGB max component (0..1), glows

knee.doc: Soft-knee width: a quadratic transition within ±knee around the threshold; 0 = hard cutoff

radius.doc: Glow spread radius as a fraction of the canvas short edge; sets the downsample level count (about log2 of the pixel radius, capped at 8 levels), with the last level weighted by the fractional part, continuous under animation

intensity.doc: Multiple of the glow added back onto the source image (additive blend)

doc: Bloom: soft-knee bright-pass (weight from the premultiplied RGB max component, Unity-style quadratic knee) → per-level 2× downsample (4×4 tent kernel [1,3,3,1]²/64, edge clamp) → per-level bilinear upsample added (b_i = a_i + up(b_{i+1}), last level weighted by the fractional part of the radius) → divided by the level count × intensity, added back onto the source (RGB and alpha added alike, result clamped to alpha ≥ RGB). All f32 arithmetic, no transcendental functions, bit-for-bit deterministic. Bright objects on a transparent background grow a glow carrying alpha.
